```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, dplyr, knitr, kableExtra, flexsurv, survival
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
}))

# Force Model A (joint) for distribution selection
MODEL_STRUCTURE <- 0

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
}))
```

```{r extract-ic-tables, include=FALSE}
# Extract AIC/BIC tables from fitted models
# Model A uses "full" structure
os_ic <- models$full$os_ic
pfs_ic <- models$full$pfs_ic

# Add rank columns
os_ic <- os_ic %>%
  filter(!is.na(AIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    AIC_rank = rank(AIC),
    BIC_rank = rank(BIC),
    delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC)
  )

pfs_ic <- pfs_ic %>%
  filter(!is.na(AIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    AIC_rank = rank(AIC),
    BIC_rank = rank(BIC),
    delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC)
  )

cat("OS distributions fitted:", nrow(os_ic), "\n")
cat("PFS distributions fitted:", nrow(pfs_ic), "\n")
cat("Best OS distribution:", os_ic$Distribution[1], "(AIC:", round(os_ic$AIC[1], 2), ")\n")
cat("Best PFS distribution:", pfs_ic$Distribution[1], "(AIC:", round(pfs_ic$AIC[1], 2), ")\n")
```

## Overall Survival

```{r display-os-table}
os_display <- os_ic %>%
  mutate(
    AIC = sprintf("%.2f", AIC),
    BIC = sprintf("%.2f", BIC),
    delta_AIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_AIC),
    delta_BIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_BIC)
  ) %>%
  select(Distribution, AIC, delta_AIC, BIC, delta_BIC, AIC_rank)

kable(os_display,
      caption = "Overall survival: parametric distribution comparison (Model A)",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Distribution", "AIC", "Delta AIC", "BIC", "Delta BIC", "AIC Rank"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 5))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f5e9")
```

## Progression-Free Survival

```{r display-pfs-table}
pfs_display <- pfs_ic %>%
  mutate(
    AIC = sprintf("%.2f", AIC),
    BIC = sprintf("%.2f", BIC),
    delta_AIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_AIC),
    delta_BIC = sprintf("%.2f", delta_BIC)
  ) %>%
  select(Distribution, AIC, delta_AIC, BIC, delta_BIC, AIC_rank)

kable(pfs_display,
      caption = "Progression-free survival: parametric distribution comparison (Model A)",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Distribution", "AIC", "Delta AIC", "BIC", "Delta BIC", "AIC Rank"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 5))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f5e9")
```

```{r combined-summary}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Endpoint = c("Overall survival", "Progression-free survival"),
  `Best distribution` = c(os_ic$Distribution[1], pfs_ic$Distribution[1]),
  AIC = c(os_ic$AIC[1], pfs_ic$AIC[1]),
  `Second best` = c(os_ic$Distribution[2], pfs_ic$Distribution[2]),
  `Delta AIC` = c(os_ic$delta_AIC[2], pfs_ic$delta_AIC[2]),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(summary_df,
      caption = "Table S3: Summary of parametric distribution selection",
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Models fitted to Model A (joint) specification: Surv ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx.",
      "Gamma distribution selected for both endpoints based on lowest AIC, BIC concordance, and clinical plausibility of extrapolations.",
      "Delta AIC/BIC = difference from best-fitting model. Distributions with Delta AIC >10 have essentially no empirical support.",
      "Candidate distributions: exponential, Weibull, Weibull PH, log-logistic, log-normal, gamma, Gompertz, generalized gamma, generalized F."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

combined_ic <- rbind(
  os_ic %>% mutate(Endpoint = "OS"),
  pfs_ic %>% mutate(Endpoint = "PFS")
)

write.csv(combined_ic, file = here("tables", "table_s3.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s3.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S3 has been saved to `tables/table_s3.csv`.
